subject: english
prompt: 在校園圖書館第1585449週的課堂活動中，在「1-Ⅳ-9：語調所表達的情緒態度」能力練習中，Which sentence best summarizes this message: 'Please bring a reusable bottle on Friday.'？

options.text: Students should bring a new desk on Monday.
The bottle is not allowed on Friday.
The message is about a school holiday.
Students should bring a reusable bottle on Friday.

answer.explanation: The summary keeps the item and the day stated in the message. 本題對應 KG「1-Ⅳ-9：語調所表達的情緒態度」，情境為校園圖書館第1585449次資料。
